title: “Kya family planning after marriage hoti hai?”: Integrating Cultural Sensitivity in an LLM Chatbot for Reproductive Health
benchmark_measurement: The chatbot's ability to respond to user queries involving religious beliefs about reproductive health by providing medically accurate information while respecting cultural norms and religious prohibitions.
findings: The chatbot was able to handle user queries involving religious beliefs (e.g., prohibitions on sterilization) by offering medically accurate, non-surgical alternatives and suggesting consultation with a religious leader, thereby balancing medical advice with respect for the user's cultural and religious context. This diplomatic approach was a deliberate design choice to maintain user trust.
